text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Sev1 - Smart routing anomaly detected. Automatic page to oncall-uk. Symptom summary: hosted requests for us-west are looping through region fallback and spilling into dedicated pool with the wrong model_variant applied -> dedicated runtime returning 5xx/segfaults. Thread TS 1768000000

pager-duty: paging oncall-uk :rotating_light:

oncall-uk: taking it. any quick context on customer impact?

product-sup_cara: multiple enterprise customers (acme-inc, beta-saas, gamma-retail) reporting chat failures and 502/504s. We have screenshots and request IDs, sending in DMs.

ml_ops_jordan: looking at model routing logs — numerous requests that should map to hosted_variant=v1.9 are being routed to dedicated with variant==v-next-quantized, which our dedicated runtime doesn't support (missing q8 kernels). Logs show runtime error: "UnsupportedQuantProfile: q8 not available on this SKU" causing 5xx.

eng_miguel: router traces show fallback loop: region preference -> hosted attempt -> capacity spike -> fallback to dedicated -> dedicated reports capacity -> route back to hosted (but sticky session and variant override remains) -> repeat. There's also a policy field 'fallback_variant' that was introduced last week. It looks like it overrides variant mapping during fallback.

eng_miguel: snippet from policy eval (redacted):
```
policy {
  match: region == "us-west"
  fallback: dedicated
  fallback_variant: preferred_variant == "next"  # BAD
}
```

infra-ryan: that `fallback_variant` key came from PR 2345 (routing feature). I triaged the deploys — PR landed in control-plane on Wed. Could be a regression.

oncall-uk: mitigation plan (short):
1) disable fallback_variant override in policy engine (fast kill)
2) force-route critical tenants back to hosted pool (map by tenant id)
3) evict sticky sessions on dedicated nodes and restart affected nodes if needed
4) monitor 5xx/latency and keep customers updated
I'll start 1 and 2 now.

eng_miguel: running disable (control plane API):
`curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/api/policies/2345/disable?force=true -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'` -> 200 OK

incident-bot: Policy 2345 disable recorded by oncall-uk at 1768000067.

ml_ops_jordan: after disable, variant mapping should revert to hosted_variant resolution. However sticky sessions in the dedicated pool will still have the wrong model variant assigned in their session metadata. Need eviction for tenants acme-inc and beta-saas.

infra-ryan: running eviction script for tenants now:
```
for tenant in acme-inc beta-saas; do
  ./tools/evict_sessions --pool dedicated --tenant "$tenant" --reason "variant_mismatch_fallback" --force
done
```

infra-ryan: eviction command returned: acme-inc -> evicted (45 sessions), beta-saas -> evicted (62 sessions).

product-sup_cara: acme-inc reports partial recovery (chat restored for subset of users). Beta-saas still seeing ~30% error rate on some routes.

eng_miguel: I see leftover traffic pinned due to routing cache TTL. Flushing region cache for us-west to clear sticky pinning.

oncall-uk: API call: `POST https://controlplane.internal/api/cache/flush?region=us-west` -> 202 Accepted. incident-bot logged event flush_us-west_1768000123.

incident-bot: Cache flush recorded (flush_us-west_1768000123).

ml_ops_jordan: after eviction + cache flush, dedicated error rates dropped. Model variant mapping re-synced to v1.9. 5xx rate returned to baseline across impacted tenants. Monitoring trend: peak 5xx at 27% for ~22 minutes.

product-sup_cara: customer impact summary for postmortem draft:
- impacted customers: acme-inc, beta-saas, gamma-retail (3)
- peak error rate: ~27%
- duration (mitigation start -> major recovery): ~22 minutes (1768000067 -> 1768001400)
- visible symptoms: 502/504, increased latency, chat hangs
- root cause (prelim): control-plane regression from PR 2345 introducing `fallback_variant` override, combined with routing cache TTL + sticky session behavior on dedicated pools resulting in mismatch of model binary to runtime capabilities.

eng_miguel: action items: revert/patch PR 2345 to remove fallback_variant behavior or make it explicit and gated; add preflight tests that validate variant compatibility across pools; add automated alert when model_variant mismatch errors spike; reduce cache TTL for fallback routing keys.

infra-ryan: infra actions: node runtime should log variant mismatch more clearly (include tenant and session id), add scripted eviction helper in control-plane for rapid tenants-level evictions.

product-sup_cara: I'm sending a customer-facing status email summarizing mitigation and ETA for postmortem.

oncall-uk: handing to SRE rotation for follow-up. tagging eng_miguel and ml_ops_jordan for postmortem. /me ends pager :white_check_mark:

sre_emily: taking follow-up ownership for postmortem. I'll coordinate a deep-dive and link to this thread. Adding labels: incident:smart-routing, severity:sev1, area:control-plane.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation at 1768001800. Final logging will be attached to postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
